Container.Name: incipit-api
Container.Overview:
Audiobook metadata API for the Incipit Plex agent - a SINGLE container. Storage is a built-in SQLite file and caching is in-process, so there is no mongo, no redis, no inter-container networking and nothing else to start first. Backup = one file (or `docker exec incipit-api bun run backup`).
Fans out across Audible, Apple Books, Hardcover, OpenLibrary, OverDrive and Storytel, scores candidates on title, author and runtime, and returns them ranked - which is the piece audnexus never had: a way to find a non-Audible book so it can appear in Plex.
THE DATA PATH MATTERS. Point /data at a CACHE-POOL path (/mnt/cache/appdata/...), never the /mnt/user FUSE view - SQLite file locking over FUSE is a corruption vector (Plex's own appdata follows the same rule). The container runs as uid 1000 and must own the directory: chown 1000:1000 the host path once before first start, or boot fails with "cannot open database".
TAGS: :nightly tracks the default branch, :release is stable. There is no :latest worth using here - it builds from release only, so pulling it after a nightly change is a silent no-op.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Host port the Plex agent connects to. The container always listens on 3000.

Config.Name: Database path (/data)
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database lives. USE A CACHE-POOL PATH (/mnt/cache/appdata/...), never /mnt/user - SQLite over the FUSE view is a corruption vector. chown 1000:1000 this directory once before first start (the container runs as uid 1000 and creates incipit.db, -wal and -shm here).

Config.Name: DB_BACKEND
Config.Description: Storage backend. 'sqlite' (recommended, self-contained) or 'mongo' (legacy; needs MONGODB_URI and an external mongo).

Config.Name: SQLITE_PATH
Config.Description: Database file inside the container. Leave as /data/incipit.db unless you know why.

Config.Name: MONGODB_URI
Config.Description: LEGACY, mongo backend only. Leave blank under sqlite. If set with DB_BACKEND=mongo, the mongo container must share a user-defined docker network with this one (bridge does not resolve container names).

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Optional. LEAVE BLANK to use the built-in in-process cache (recommended; no redis container needed). Set only to keep an external redis.

Config.Name: HARDCOVER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Your own Hardcover API token. Optional - blank simply skips that provider. Nothing is bundled.

Config.Name: OL_CONTACT
Config.Description: Contact string sent to OpenLibrary as courtesy identification, e.g. an email. Optional.

Config.Name: GOODREADS_SERIES_URL
Config.Description: Optional rreading-glasses instance for Goodreads series data (e.g. http://10.0.1.99:8788). Blank uses the public api.bookinfo.pro mirror, which rate-limits shared traffic.

Config.Name: RATE_LIMIT_ALLOWLIST
Config.Description: CIDR-aware allowlist. Direct requests from private/loopback space (the Plex agent's docker-bridge hop) are exempt automatically; set this only for proxied clients that need exemption. Example: 10.0.0.0/24

Config.Name: DEFAULT_REGION
Config.Description: Audible marketplace to search by default: us, uk, ca, au, de, fr, it, es, in, jp.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug or trace.

Config.Name: METRICS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Expose /metrics with match-decision counters. Gate it with METRICS_ALLOWED_IPS - open mode redacts detail, but an allowlisted LAN client sees full recent decisions.
